sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Villain checks. Hero bets $400. Villain folds.

Now before you call me crazy, put yourself in Villain’s shoes. What does he beat? | guess you could say he beats offsuit K-Q, K-10, and Q-10 combos but that’s only if Hero is defending against a 3-bet with those hands. The hijack’s defense range versus the small blind should be quite a bit tighter than it would be if he was on the button.

Now how often do you see someone turn 7¥-7& into a multi-street bluff on this board? Almost never. That’s why this play is so effective. Villain is greedy. He isn’t checking A-x enough. His range is severly capped. Punish him.
Pro tip: Squeeze with suited Broadways in position.
